description: backup-get-expired-backups.md's example response returns two distinct arrays: `expired_backups` and `expired_backups_with_non_expired_dependents`. The field name strongly implies the Backup Service tracks, and treats differently, expired backups that still have non-expired incremental backups depending on them - directly paralleling backup-delete-backups.md's disable_safe_remove_check dependency guard (backup:safe-remove-check) and the confirmed full-backup/incremental-backup dependency chain. But the page supplies only the field name and one example value, with no prose explaining what happens differently to a backup in that second category (is it excluded from automatic pruning? does it require disable_safe_remove_check to prune?).
